requirements.title: LOGICAL argument restrictions
requirements.definition: L shall be logical, and optional KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.LOGICAL-L-logical: Positive source controls call LOGICAL with .true. and .false. values; a source-control mutation uses a nonlogical actual and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.LOGICAL-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-exp: Positive source control calls LOGICAL with KIND=KIND(.true.); source-control mutations use a noninteger or nonconstant KIND expression and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: LOGICAL result type and kind follow KIND presence or default logical
requirements.definition: The LOGICAL result is logical; with KIND present its kind type parameter is the value of KIND, and with KIND absent its kind type parameter is default logical.

pending.LOGICAL-result-logical-type: Assign LOGICAL(.true.) and LOGICAL(.false.) to logical variables initialized to the opposite values and assert the exact truth values, proving the result is logical and usable in logical context; mutate LOGICAL to INT in source review so assignment is rejected outside this facet.
pending.LOGICAL-result-kind-from-KIND: Guarded plan probes for a nondefault logical kind via SELECTED_LOGICAL_KIND; after availability is established, evaluate LOGICAL(.true., KIND=that_kind), assert KIND(...) equals that kind, and mutate KIND to KIND(.true.) so the kind check fails. The default-kind control exercises KIND presence without claiming nondefault coverage on processors lacking another kind.
pending.LOGICAL-result-default-kind-absent: Evaluate LOGICAL(.true.) and assert KIND(...) equals KIND(.true.); companion LOGICAL(.true., KIND=KIND(.true.)) guards against an absent-call parser special case.

requirements.title: LOGICAL result value equals L
requirements.definition: The value of LOGICAL(L) is that of L.

pending.LOGICAL-result-value-equals-L: Initialize one result to .false. and one to .true.; assign LOGICAL(.true.) and LOGICAL(.false.) respectively and assert .true. and .false. exactly. Mutate L to .NOT. L so both sentinel-protected checks fail.
